audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[N].side disagreed with content win[N] on 5 of 7 rows: side=Skill on rows 0,1,2,4 while win=Sivir, and side=Skill on row 5 while win=Jinx. Rows 3 and 6 already agreed.
audit.why: win[] matches the packet's levelChart exactly (Sivir,Sivir,Sivir,Skill,Sivir,Jinx,Jinx). Sivir's kit backs it: Boomerang Blade poke and superior wave push let her control lane from Level 1, Ricochet adds more wave pressure at 2, Spell Shield shuts down engage tools by 3, On The Hunt at 6 lets her dodge Death Rocket and dictate tempo, then Jinx's first item flips it as Fishbones outranges her Q and Get Excited resets take over.
audit.corrected: Moved phases[0,1,2,4,5].side to match win[], rewrote their .why to state the grounded reason, and adjusted ratings. Rows 3 (Levels 4-5, both Skill) and 6 (both Jinx) were already correct and untouched.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Spell Shield as matchup-defining but has no digit anywhere.
audit.why: Spell Shield (E) is 24/22.5/21/19.5/18s — a long cooldown, so once it's baited out Jinx has a real 18-24s window where her rockets, W slow, and chompers all land clean.
audit.corrected: Added the real E cooldown range to breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d is a verbatim copy of tradeGood pasted under a chomper-pick-attempt title, dontsFull[2].d is a verbatim copy of tradeBad pasted under a greed-plates title, and missingInteractions flags that Sivir's Spell Shield (E) can wall off Jinx's retreat since Jinx has no dash.
audit.why: dosFull[1]'s title promises chomper timing on Sivir's pick attempt, not generic trade discipline; dontsFull[2]'s title warns about greeding plates, not generic dueling. Jinx has zero mobility tools besides W's slow, so if Sivir uses Spell Shield's terrain flag to cut an escape route, only Flash saves the fight.
audit.corrected: Rewrote dosFull[1].d around chomper timing vs her engage, dontsFull[2].d around Sivir's wave-shove threatening plates, and folded the Spell-Shield-terrain retreat warning into breakdown.cooldowns alongside the real cooldown number.
